value.answer: Lowest 5-year fixed I can see right now is 4.34% for an insured mortgage (under 20% down), with Frank Mortgage at that rate. The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.17%, and rates are climbing again: BMO and CIBC both went up 20 bps this month. If you're putting down 20% or more, the lowest I can see is 4.64%.
